reviewScope.summary: Focused V4 copy integration review. Approved text replacements, preserved seven-module curriculum, generated assets and selected technical checks. No independent runtime execution.
evidence: Canonical pilot compared against published baseline: exactly 25 approved string changes; 7 modules, 73 units and 346 exercises preserved.
All 28 unrelated authoring rebuild differences excluded.
Existing product exporter and --check passed for 12 generated files.
PowerShell copy replacement reported 20 repo copy changes and two Guild copy changes.
TypeScript typecheck and Vite production build passed.
Focused Vitest: 21 curriculum and 14 Pathways tests passed; 35 total.
Prettier and staged git diff --check passed. Full local release suite not run.
Hosted run 43325731295 failed at an immediate focus assertion in the backup restore test. The existing focus requirement is preserved using waitFor. The focused suite passed locally after correction.

Hosted run 43327138968 exposed stale Git/GitHub content assets after approved canonical copy changes. The existing Git/GitHub exporter was rerun and checked. The two affected content suites passed locally.

Audited the 1095-file PR #92 source ZIP, including 308 tests/E2E files and 45 owner-approved copy originals. One remaining obsolete four-word copy assertion was identified and removed; functional XP, progress, reward, and evidence assertions remain unchanged.
One complete local Vitest run with bail disabled passed on this corrected candidate. Playwright and hosted Final candidate were not run locally for this correction.

adversarialFindings.resolution: Removed only the legacy phrase assertion, preserving all actual XP, progress, reward and evidence checks. Reviewed the provided full test-source archive for other obsolete approved wording; relevant local tests passed.
